name: Above the Law
text:
When you score this agenda, you may trash 1 installed resource.
Limit 1 per deck.

name: AMAZE Amusements
text: Persistent → Whenever a run on this server ends, if the Runner stole any agendas during that run, give the Runner 2 tags. (If the Runner trashes this card while accessing it, this ability still applies for the remainder of this run.)

name: Anoetic Void
text: Whenever the Runner approaches this server, you may pay 2[credit] and trash 2 cards from HQ. If you do, end the run.

name: Ansel 1.0
text: Lose [click]: Break 1 subroutine on this ice. Only the Runner can use this ability. [subroutine] Trash 1 installed Runner card. [subroutine] You may install 1 card from HQ or Archives. [subroutine] The Runner cannot steal or trash Corp cards for the remainder of this run.

name: Ballista
text: [subroutine] Trash 1 installed program or end the run.

name: Botulus
text: Install only on a piece of ice. (If the host ice is uninstalled, this program is trashed.) When you install this program and when your turn begins, place 1 virus counter on this program. Hosted virus counter: Break 1 subroutine on host ice.

name: Brân 1.0
text: Lose [click]: Break 1 subroutine on this ice. Only the Runner can use this ability. [subroutine] You may install 1 piece of ice from HQ or Archives directly inward from this ice, ignoring all costs. [subroutine] End the run. [subroutine] End the run.

name: Buzzsaw
text: Interface → 1[credit]: Break up to 2 code gate subroutines. 3[credit]: +1 strength.

name: Carmen
text: If you made a successful run this turn, this program costs 2[credit] less to install. Interface → 1[credit]: Break 1 sentry subroutine. 2[credit]: +3 strength.

name: Carnivore
text: +1[mu] Access, once per turn → Trash 2 cards from your grip: Trash the card you are accessing. Limit 1 console per player.

name: Clearinghouse
text:
You can advance this asset.
When your turn begins, you may trash this asset to do 1 meat damage for each hosted advancement counter.

name: Cleaver
text: Interface → 1[credit]: Break up to 2 barrier subroutines. 2[credit]: +1 strength.

name: Conduit
text: Whenever a successful run on R&D ends, you may place 1 virus counter on this program. [click]: Run R&D. If successful, access X additional cards when you breach R&D. X is equal to the number of hosted virus counters.

name: Cookbook
text: Whenever you install a virus program, you may place 1 virus counter on it.

name: Creative Commission
text: Gain 5[credit]. If you have any [click] remaining, lose [click].

name: Diviner
text: [subroutine] Do 1 net damage. If you trash a card this way with a printed play or install cost that is an odd number, end the run. (0 is not odd.)

name: Docklands Pass
text: The first time each turn you breach HQ, access 1 additional card.

name: DZMZ Optimizer
text:
+1[mu]
The first program you install each turn costs 1[credit] less to install.

name: Echelon
text: This program gets +1 strength for each installed icebreaker (including this one). Interface → 1[credit]: Break 1 sentry subroutine. 3[credit]: +2 strength.

name: Fermenter
text: When you install this program and when your turn begins, place 1 virus counter on this program. [click], [trash]: Gain 2[credit] for each hosted virus counter.

name: Funhouse
text:
When the Runner encounters this ice, end the run unless the Runner takes 1 tag.
[subroutine] Give the Runner 1 tag unless they pay 4[credit].

name: Government Subsidy
text: Gain 15[credit].

name: Haas-Bioroid: Precision Design
text:
You get +1 maximum hand size.
Whenever you score an agenda, you may add 1 card from Archives to HQ.

name: Hansei Review
text: Gain 10[credit]. If there are any cards in HQ, trash 1 of them.

name: Hedge Fund
text: Gain 9[credit].

name: Jailbreak
text: Run HQ or R&D. If successful, draw 1 card and when you breach the attacked server, access 1 additional card.

name: Jinteki: Restoring Humanity
text: When your discard phase ends, if there is a facedown card in Archives, gain 1[credit].

name: Karunā
text:
[subroutine] Do 2 net damage. The Runner may jack out.
[subroutine] Do 2 net damage.

name: Leech
text: Whenever you make a successful run on a central server, place 1 virus counter on this program. Hosted virus counter: The ice you are encountering gets -1 strength for the remainder of this encounter.

name: Longevity Serum
text:
When you score this agenda, trash any number of cards from HQ. Shuffle up to 3 cards from Archives into R&D.
Limit 1 per deck.

name: Luminal Transubstantiation
text:
When you score this agenda, gain [click][click][click]. You cannot score agendas for the remainder of the turn.
Limit 1 per deck.

name: Malapert Data Vault
text: Whenever you score an agenda from the root of this server, you may search R&D for 1 non-agenda card and reveal it. (Shuffle R&D after searching it.) Add that card to HQ.

name: Manegarm Skunkworks
text: Whenever the Runner approaches this server, end the run unless they either spend [click][click] or pay 5[credit].

name: Marjanah
text: Interface → 2[credit]: Break 1 barrier subroutine. If you made a successful run this turn, this ability costs 1[credit] less to use. 1[credit]: +1 strength.

name: Mayfly
text: Interface → 1[credit]: Break 1 subroutine. When this run ends, trash this program. 1[credit]: +1 strength.

name: Mutual Favor
text: Search your stack for 1 icebreaker and reveal it. (Shuffle your stack after searching it.) If you made a successful run this turn, you may install that program. If you do not, add it to your grip.

name: NBN: Reality Plus
text: The first time each turn the Runner takes a tag, gain 2[credit] or draw 2 cards.

name: Neurospike
text: Do X net damage, where X is equal to the sum of the printed agenda points on agendas you scored this turn.

name: Nico Campaign
text:
When you rez this asset, load 9[credit] onto it. When it is empty, trash it and draw 1 card.
When your turn begins, take 3[credit] from this asset.

name: Offworld Office
text: When you score this agenda, gain 7[credit].

name: Orbital Superiority
text: When you score this agenda, if the Runner is tagged, do 4 meat damage; otherwise, give the Runner 1 tag.

name: Overclock
text: Place 5[credit] on this event, then run any server. You can spend hosted credits during that run.

name: Palisade
text:
While this ice is protecting a remote server, it gets +2 strength.
[subroutine] End the run.

name: Pantograph
text: +1[mu] Whenever an agenda is scored or stolen, gain 1[credit]. Then, you may install 1 card from your grip. Limit 1 console per player.

name: Pennyshaver
text: +1[mu] Whenever you make a successful run, place 1[credit] on this hardware. [click]: Place 1[credit] on this hardware, then take all credits from it. Limit 1 console per player.

name: Pharos
text:
You can advance this ice. It gets +5 strength while there are 3 or more hosted advancement counters.
[subroutine] Give the Runner 1 tag.
[subroutine] End the run.
[subroutine] End the run.

name: Ping
text:
When you rez this ice during a run against this server, give the Runner 1 tag.
[subroutine] End the run.

name: Predictive Planogram
text:
Resolve 1 of the following. If the Runner is tagged, you may resolve both instead.
  • Gain 3[credit].
  • Draw 3 cards.

name: Public Trail
text:
Play only if the Runner made a successful run during their last turn.
Give the Runner 1 tag unless they pay 8[credit].

name: Red Team
text: When you install this resource, load 12[credit] onto it. When it is empty, trash it. [click]: Run a central server you have not run this turn. If successful, take 3[credit] from this resource.

name: Regolith Mining License
text: When you rez this asset, load 15[credit] onto it. When it is empty, trash it. [click]: Take 3[credit] from this asset.

name: René “Loup” Arcemont: Party Animal
text: The first time each turn you trash a card you are accessing, gain 1[credit] and draw 1 card.

name: Retribution
text:
Play only if the Runner is tagged.
Trash 1 installed program or piece of hardware.

name: Seamless Launch
text: Place 2 advancement counters on 1 installed card that you did not install this turn.

name: Send a Message
text: When this agenda is scored or stolen, you may rez 1 installed piece of ice, ignoring all costs.

name: Smartware Distributor
text: [click]: Place 3[credit] on this resource. When your turn begins, take 1[credit] from this resource.

name: Spin Doctor
text: When you rez this asset, draw 2 cards. Remove this asset from the game: Shuffle up to 2 cards from Archives into R&D.

name: Sprint
text: Draw 3 cards. Shuffle 2 cards from HQ into R&D.

name: Superconducting Hub
text:
When you score this agenda, you may draw 2 cards.
You get +2 maximum hand size.

name: Sure Gamble
text: Gain 9[credit].

name: T400 Memory Diamond
text:
+1[mu]
You get +1 maximum hand size.

name: Tāo Salonga: Telepresence Magician
text: Whenever an agenda is scored or stolen, you may swap 2 installed pieces of ice.

name: Telework Contract
text: When you install this resource, load 9[credit] onto it. When it is empty, trash it. Once per turn → [click]: Take 3[credit] from this resource.

name: The Catalyst: Convention Breaker
text: Starter game only.

name: The Syndicate: Profit over Principle
text: Starter game only.

name: Tithe
text:
[subroutine] Do 1 net damage.
[subroutine] Gain 1[credit].

name: Tomorrowʼs Headline
text:
When this agenda is scored or stolen, give the Runner 1 tag.
Limit 1 per deck.

name: Tranquilizer
text: Install only on a piece of ice. (If the host ice is uninstalled, this program is trashed.) When you install this program and when your turn begins, place 1 virus counter on this program. Then, if there are 3 or more hosted virus counters, derez host ice.

name: Tread Lightly
text: Run any server. During that run, the rez cost of each piece of ice is increased by 3[credit].

name: Unity
text: Interface → 1[credit]: Break 1 code gate subroutine. 1[credit]: +X strength. X is equal to the number of installed icebreakers (including this one).

name: Urtica Cipher
text:
You can advance this asset.
When the Runner accesses this asset while it is installed, do 2 net damage plus 1 net damage for each hosted advancement counter.

name: Verbal Plasticity
text: The first time each turn you take the basic action to draw 1 card, instead draw 2 cards.

name: VRcation
text: Draw 4 cards. If you have any [click] remaining, lose [click].

name: Weyland Consortium: Built to Last
text: Whenever you advance a card, gain 2[credit] if it had no advancement counters.

name: Whitespace
text:
[subroutine] The Runner loses 3[credit].
[subroutine] If the Runner has 6[credit] or less, end the run.

name: Wildcat Strike
text:
Resolve 1 of the following of the Corpʼs choice:
  • Gain 6[credit].
  • Draw 4 cards.

name: Zahya Sadeghi: Versatile Smuggler
text: Once per turn → When a run on HQ or R&D ends, you may gain 1[credit] for each time you accessed a card during that run.
